inequalities.inequality: the imposed speed realises the declared dimensionless offset at each stiffness
startup_discard >> gamma/k_t, so the record begins at steady state
Reynolds number << 1, so the overdamped model holds

precondition.requires: the plan must state the fluid density this premise rests on. THE NUMBER WAS WRITTEN HERE AND REMOVED: rho*v*d/eta needs a density, the store carries water's VISCOSITY and not its density, and a literal 1000 in the formula made check 17 report a dimension of L**3/M -- the check catching a constant smuggled in without its units, which is what P2 is for. The Peclet number beside it needs no density and is computed. By hand the Reynolds number is of order 1e-7 across the sweep, so the premise is not in doubt; what is missing is a graded number to stand it on

inequalities.inequality: the steady-state offset stays inside the trap's quadratic range

precondition.requires: the plan must record that this is NOT CHECKABLE IN THIS MODEL, which is this axis's main finding. The potential is harmonic by declaration, so it has no linear range to leave and no maximum restoring force to exceed: the particle never escapes at any speed. On the bench both end a drag calibration, and the fast end of this sweep is where they would -- at the soft corner the largest offset is ten bead diameters, which no real optical trap survives. So the model reports the method working over a range the instrument does not have, and no run of it can detect that. kb:trap_escape_force is absent, so there is not even a number to compare against. Declaring a maximum trap force is the person's call and makes a different configuration rather than setting a parameter

note: A7 STOPS ABSTAINING HERE, which is the structural difference from every other configuration this agent has run. It also owns the speed outright: because the statistics depend on the offset in thermal widths and not on the speed, the goal carries the dimensionless corners and this axis turns them into a speed at each stiffness. The one inequality it cannot close is the one that matters most for the bench, and it is a limit of the declared model rather than of the protocol.

numbers.name: bead_diameter
numbers.note: the SI anchor: the particle in the bottle, measured directly. Sets the drag through Stokes and the soft end of the stiffness sweep through the thermal width

numbers.name: temperature
numbers.note: a parameter of the noise amplitude and realised exactly by the model, not a thermostat setpoint. The room's reading; nothing actuates the sample (kb:sample_temperature_not_actuated)

numbers.name: viscosity
numbers.note: pure water, validity 288 to 298 K and the temperature above is inside it. THE ENTRY SAYS `of order` one mPa s, so this is one significant figure and the precision below says so

numbers.name: diffusivity
numbers.note: the free diffusivity of the anchor sphere. Here it is not the observable but the noise scale: it sets how long the offset must be averaged

numbers.name: sigma_over_diameter_soft_corner
numbers.note: the thermal width at the soft end as a fraction of the diameter. Revision 3 ASSUMED this and derived the soft stiffness from it; now the stiffness is the person's and this is derived from it

numbers.name: trap_stiffness_max
numbers.note: the stiff end of the person's range: two decades, so three stiffness levels a decade apart

numbers.name: trap_relaxation_time_min
numbers.note: gamma/k_t at the stiff end: the shortest characteristic time, which sets the timestep

numbers.name: trap_relaxation_time_max
numbers.note: gamma/k_t at the soft end: the longest relaxation time, which sets the record length

numbers.name: offset_over_sigma_max
numbers.note: two decades up, where a single frame already shows the offset. The SPEED this becomes depends on the stiffness, so the speed is an A7 interval per corner and not one number here

numbers.name: flow_speed_max_soft_corner
numbers.note: v = (offset/sigma)*sigma/tau_t. THE SPEED IS NOT ONE NUMBER FOR THE SWEEP: the same speed is a large offset in a soft trap and invisible in a stiff one, so A7 returns a speed per stiffness and the goal carries the dimensionless corner instead

numbers.name: flow_speed_max_stiff_corner
numbers.note: the same dimensionless offset at the stiff corner needs a speed larger by sqrt(1000), because sigma falls as 1/sqrt(k_t) while tau_t falls as 1/k_t

numbers.name: peclet_number_max
numbers.note: advection against diffusion over a bead diameter. Large at the fast end, which is the point: that is where the offset is visible in a single frame

numbers.name: startup_relaxation_times
numbers.note: how many gamma/k_t to discard after the flow is switched on, before the record begins

numbers.name: startup_discard_soft_corner
numbers.note: the approach to the displaced steady state is exponential with time constant gamma/k_t, so ten of them leaves a residual offset error below a per-mille. DECLARED IN ADVANCE and evaluated by the operator, never chosen after seeing the data

assumptions.statement: The stiffness range, 0.1 to 10 pN/um, was set by the person on 2026-09-23 in answer to the question revision 3 left open. It replaces revision 3's derived corners (0.02 and 20 pN/um, from a thermal width of a tenth of a diameter). It is a decision and not an estimate.
assumptions.falsifier: the person changing the range, which is a revision and not a correction

assumptions.statement: The person has not given a speed range. Sweeping the speed directly would confound two things, because the same speed is a large offset in a soft trap and an invisible one in a stiff one. The dimensionless offset in thermal widths is what the statistics depend on, so the sweep is stated in it and A7 turns it into a speed interval at each stiffness. One to a hundred spans buried-in-noise to visible-per-frame.
assumptions.falsifier: a person's speed range replaces both ends; and on the bench the upper end is cut by trap escape, which this purely harmonic model cannot see and A7 records as a limit of the model rather than of the protocol

assumptions.statement: Ten relaxation times of discard. The displaced mean approaches its steady value as exp(-t*k_t/gamma) with no other slow mode in this model, so the residual is set purely by the multiple chosen.
assumptions.falsifier: a first run whose running mean is still drifting after ten relaxation times falsifies the single-exponential premise and therefore the model, not just the multiple

kb_refs.claim: Temperature enters the two sides differently, and the difference is not symmetric. In simulation the declared temperature is realised by construction; in the experiment nothing actuates the sample and the only thermometer reads the room, so a temperature used there is inferred. The uncertainty therefore sits entirely on the experiment side.
The laboratory's ambient temperature is 20 degrees Celsius, read off a thermometer by the operator. It is a reading and not a setpoint, and it is the room's rather than the sample's.
There is no thermometer beside the sample. The only thermometer in the laboratory reads the room, so any temperature attributed to the sample is a room reading applied to it.
The room is held continuously by air conditioning. There is a setpoint on this instrument's environment -- it is the room's, not the sample's.
The particles in the bottle in use have a diameter of 5 micrometres, with a coefficient of variation no greater than 2 per cent, measured directly by the operator on 2026-09-19.

The operator recalls not noticing a temperature change in the sample unless the infrared trapping laser was driven above roughly 20 percent on its dial. This records where noticing stopped, by means that were not recorded.
Dynamic viscosity of pure water near 293 K is of order one millipascal second, and it changes by roughly two percent per kelvin in that neighbourhood.
